The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of SMT. Akkamahadevi.

The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused No.1 got second marriage with CW-1 on 23-06-2003 and after the marriage started residing at No.221, Ayyappa swamy temple Road, Katriguppe, BSK 3 rd stage,
during stay, the accused harassed CW-1 in respect ofdemand of money and quarrelled over family issues, due to unbearable torture CW-1 left her Advocate profession. During the year 2019, the accused left CW-1 alone and separated her during epidemic disease Corona period, CW-1 was left alone in the age of 65 years,
due to loneliness , she became mentally sick, even then accused did not bothered to see her and she was suffering from cancer and heart disease, the accused left her alone and from the day of marriage, accused tortured and did not cared her and separation from her caused mental sickness to CW-1 and thus subjected CW- 1 to physical and mental cruelty.
Based on the said information, a  3  C.C.No.18908/2022 case in Cr.No.113/2022 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.

Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and was enlarged on bail.

She in her examination-in-chief has reiterated the complaint averments and she has not tendered herself for cross examination.
Since PW-1 is reported as dead, her evidence is discarded.
In support of the case of prosecution, in spite of repeated issuance of summons and warrants the jurisdictional police failed to secure the presence of CW 2 to 7.
Hence, the prayer of Sr.APP was rejected and CW-2 to 7 were dropped.
As none of the witnesses are examined by the prosecution and no evidence against the accused, the recording of Statement of Accused as required U/s. 313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed with.

11. The witnesses CW 2 to 7 cited in the charge sheet did not appeared and lead their evidence and there are no materials against accused as Cws. 2 to 7 were not secured by the prosecution, accordingly they were dropped.
This court issued summons, warrant and proclamation to Cws.2 to 7.

But the concerned police could not secure the presence of the witnesses in- Akkamahadevi Mc vs Mahesh Ml on 3 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172374885/

sentences.text: Moreover in this case complainant is dead.
The Cws.2 to 7 may not be secured  6  C.C.No.18908/2022 in near future days.
Hence, prayer of Sr.APP to reissue witness summons to Cw's was rejected and CW-2 to 7 were dropped and prosecution side evidence is taken as Nil.
Since there was no incriminating evidence against the accused, the statement of accused U/s.313 of Cr.P.C. was dispensed with.
In the absence of evidence of Cws.2 to 7, there are no material to show that the accused No.1 has committed the offence punishable u/s. 498A of IPC.
Hence, I hold that the prosecution has utterly failed to prove the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused No.1 is acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A, of IPC.
The bail bonds of accused No.1 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
